items.text: The worker loop uses <= so it makes maxRetries + 1 attempts; the client does not. That is the discrepancy worth reporting.
The worker allows 5 retries at 250ms backoff and the client 3 at 500ms. The worker loop also uses `<=`, so it makes one extra attempt.
Good catch. Check the client loop too.
